traits.leaf_form.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Gymnosperms (DELTA, 2008 onwards, version of 5 August 2019), Araucariaceae: evergreen trees with whorled main branches; leaves broad and flat with many parallel veins, or linear and mostly soft, set spirally; Agathis usually monoecious and Araucaria dioecious.

traits.cone_maturation_years.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Araucariaceae: the female cones, mostly large and nearly round, take two to three years to ripen and fall apart when the seeds are ripe (two years in Agathis).
